why: #1898 -- the Worker Threads slider was dead past ~4 workers because World.stream's in-flight budgets were fixed at 4 gen / 6 mesh. Drives the real stream against a recording Jobs stub for pools 1..12 and asserts gen = max(floor, pool), mesh = max(floor, 1.5 x pool). Breaks its own source (caps hard-wired, mesh ignoring pool, gen ignoring pool) to prove it can fail.
